description: Source file implementing video decoder support and HDR handling for UWP on Xbox One X and Series devices.

classes.name: VideoDecoderUwp
classes.description: UWP video decoder class with HDR support and device-specific configurations.

methods.name: ~VideoDecoderUwp
methods.description: Destructor that resets HDR mode if supported.

methods.name: IsHardwareVp9DecoderSupported
methods.description: Checks if hardware VP9 decoder is supported.

methods.name: IsHardwareAv1DecoderSupported
methods.description: Checks if hardware AV1 decoder is supported based on device type and other decoders.

methods.name: TryUpdateOutputForHdrVideo
methods.description: Updates HDR output settings based on stream info and device capabilities.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of frames to preroll for decoding.
